clues.text: Under the law given to Moses, an Israelite man or woman became this by making a special vow to the LORD.
Moses taught that such a person must avoid wine, grapes and raisins, even the seeds and skins.
By the law given through Moses, no razor could touch this person's head until the vow was complete.
Under Moses' law, after being near a dead body, this person brought offerings and consecrated his head again.
When the vow ended, this person shaved at the Tent of Meeting and burned the hair under the peace offering.
Manoah's wife told her husband that a man of God said her son would be this until his death.
Samson told Delilah his hair had never been cut because he had been this since his mother's womb.
